name: Shoelace
summary: MIT web-component UI kit with first-class React wrappers for every component.
gaps: Underlying tech is Lit web components; catalog frameworks lists React because official React wrappers are first-class (https://shoelace.style/frameworks/react).
Requires theme CSS import + setBasePath for icons/assets.
iframe demos only; HTML/React toggle lives on docs pages.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Action button with variants and loading states.

demo.peerNotes: Web components + official React wrappers. Docs pages toggle HTML/React examples. Theme CSS + setBasePath required.

components.copyCode:
npm install @shoelace-style/shoelace
# App setup: import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/themes/light.css'
# import { setBasePath } from '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/utilities/base-path.js'
# setBasePath('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@shoelace-style/shoelace@2.20.1/cdn/')

import SlButton from '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/react/button'

<SlButton>...</SlButton>

copyPrompt.text: Use Shoelace free MIT React wrapper `SlButton` (slug `button`) from https://shoelace.style/components/button. Shoelace is a web-component UI kit with first-class React wrappers (`@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/react/...`). Install: `npm install @shoelace-style/shoelace`, import light theme + setBasePath, then `import SlButton from '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/react/button'`. React guide: https://shoelace.style/frameworks/react. Home: https://shoelace.style. Repo: https://github.com/shoelace-style/shoelace. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shoelace-style/shoelace/next/LICENSE.md; Copyright (c) 2020 A Beautiful Site, LLC). Pricing free.
